```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sf))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(grid))

tarragones_gpkg <- file.path(
  root,
  "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/tarragones-boundaries-icgc-20260120.gpkg"
)
catalonia_gpkg <- file.path(
  root,
  "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/catalonia-counties-icgc-20260120.gpkg"
)
orthophoto_file <- file.path(
  root,
  "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/vila-seca-orthophoto-icgc-2025.jpg"
)
natural_earth_file <- file.path(
  root,
  "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/natural-earth-admin-0-countries-50m.geojson"
)

municipalities <- st_read(tarragones_gpkg, layer = "municipalities_250k", quiet = TRUE)
counties <- st_read(catalonia_gpkg, layer = "counties_250k", quiet = TRUE)
countries <- st_read(natural_earth_file, quiet = TRUE)
orthophoto <- jpeg::readJPEG(orthophoto_file)

vila_seca <- municipalities[municipalities$NOMMUNI == "Vila-seca", ]
tarragones <- counties[counties$NOMCOMAR == "Tarragonès", ]

stopifnot(
  nrow(municipalities) == 22,
  nrow(counties) == 43,
  nrow(vila_seca) == 1,
  nrow(tarragones) == 1
)

orthophoto_extent <- c(
  xmin = 338500,
  ymin = 4547350,
  xmax = 350500,
  ymax = 4556000
)

extent_polygon <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(orthophoto_extent, crs = st_crs(municipalities)))
visible_municipalities <- st_filter(municipalities, extent_polygon, .predicate = st_intersects)

draw_boundaries <- function(data, extent, style) {
  coordinates <- st_coordinates(st_boundary(data))
  group_columns <- grep("^L[0-9]+$", colnames(coordinates), value = TRUE)
  groups <- do.call(
    interaction,
    c(as.data.frame(coordinates[, group_columns, drop = FALSE]), list(drop = TRUE))
  )

  for (points in split(as.data.frame(coordinates), groups)) {
    grid.lines(
      x = (points$X - extent["xmin"]) / (extent["xmax"] - extent["xmin"]),
      y = (points$Y - extent["ymin"]) / (extent["ymax"] - extent["ymin"]),
      default.units = "npc",
      gp = style
    )
  }
}

counties_wgs84 <- st_transform(counties, 4326)
tarragones_wgs84 <- st_transform(tarragones, 4326)
catalonia_label <- st_sf(
  label = "Catalunya",
  geometry = st_point_on_surface(st_union(counties_wgs84))
)
vila_seca_marker <- st_transform(
  st_sf(name = "Vila-seca", geometry = st_point_on_surface(st_union(vila_seca))),
  4326
)
territorial_land <- countries[countries$ADMIN %in% c("Spain", "France", "Andorra"), ]
catalonia_box <- st_bbox(counties_wgs84)
catalonia_x_padding <- as.numeric(catalonia_box["xmax"] - catalonia_box["xmin"]) * 0.20
catalonia_y_padding <- as.numeric(catalonia_box["ymax"] - catalonia_box["ymin"]) * 0.12

territorial_context_tarragones <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = territorial_land, fill = "#dedbd1", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.18) +
  geom_sf(data = counties_wgs84, fill = "#f1eee5", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.16) +
  geom_sf(data = tarragones_wgs84, fill = "#d9573f", color = "#813022", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = catalonia_label,
    aes(label = label),
    angle = 32,
    color = "#45565d",
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "DejaVu Sans"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(catalonia_box["xmin"] - catalonia_x_padding, catalonia_box["xmax"] + catalonia_x_padding),
    ylim = c(catalonia_box["ymin"] - catalonia_y_padding, catalonia_box["ymax"] + catalonia_y_padding),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +
  theme_void(base_family = "DejaVu Sans") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#b9dbea", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#ffffff", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 1.2),
    plot.margin = margin(7, 7, 7, 7)
  )

territorial_context_vila_seca <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = territorial_land, fill = "#dedbd1", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.18) +
  geom_sf(data = counties_wgs84, fill = "#f1eee5", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.16) +
  geom_sf(
    data = vila_seca_marker,
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.8,
    stroke = 1.2,
    fill = "#d9472f",
    color = "#ffffff"
  ) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = catalonia_label,
    aes(label = label),
    angle = 32,
    color = "#45565d",
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "DejaVu Sans"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(catalonia_box["xmin"] - catalonia_x_padding, catalonia_box["xmax"] + catalonia_x_padding),
    ylim = c(catalonia_box["ymin"] - catalonia_y_padding, catalonia_box["ymax"] + catalonia_y_padding),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +
  theme_void(base_family = "DejaVu Sans") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#b9dbea", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#ffffff", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 1.2),
    plot.margin = margin(7, 7, 7, 7)
  )

tarragones_box <- st_bbox(tarragones)
tarragones_width <- as.numeric(tarragones_box["xmax"] - tarragones_box["xmin"])
tarragones_height <- as.numeric(tarragones_box["ymax"] - tarragones_box["ymin"])
tarragones_extent <- c(
  xmin = as.numeric(tarragones_box["xmin"]) - tarragones_width * 0.18,
  xmax = as.numeric(tarragones_box["xmax"]) + tarragones_width * 0.22,
  ymin = as.numeric(tarragones_box["ymin"]) - tarragones_height * 0.30,
  ymax = as.numeric(tarragones_box["ymax"]) + tarragones_height * 0.27
)
tarragones_map_width <- tarragones_extent["xmax"] - tarragones_extent["xmin"]
tarragones_map_height <- tarragones_extent["ymax"] - tarragones_extent["ymin"]
tarragones_scale_end <- tarragones_extent["xmax"] - tarragones_map_width * 0.05
tarragones_scale_start <- tarragones_scale_end - 5000
tarragones_scale_y <- tarragones_extent["ymin"] + tarragones_map_height * 0.09
tarragones_north_x <- tarragones_scale_start - tarragones_map_width * 0.14

tarragones_detail <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = counties, fill = "#dfe4e3", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = tarragones, fill = "#f1eee5", color = "#73858d", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = municipalities, fill = "#f1eee5", color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_sf(data = vila_seca, fill = "#d9472f", color = "#813022", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = tarragones_scale_start,
    xend = tarragones_scale_end,
    y = tarragones_scale_y,
    yend = tarragones_scale_y,
    color = "#17384a",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = c(tarragones_scale_start, tarragones_scale_end),
    xend = c(tarragones_scale_start, tarragones_scale_end),
    y = tarragones_scale_y - tarragones_map_height * 0.009,
    yend = tarragones_scale_y + tarragones_map_height * 0.009,
    color = "#17384a",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = (tarragones_scale_start + tarragones_scale_end) / 2,
    y = tarragones_scale_y + tarragones_map_height * 0.045,
    label = "5 km",
    color = "#17384a",
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "DejaVu Sans"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = tarragones_north_x,
    xend = tarragones_north_x,
    y = tarragones_scale_y - tarragones_map_height * 0.002,
    yend = tarragones_scale_y + tarragones_map_height * 0.065,
    color = "#17384a",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.16, "cm"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = tarragones_north_x,
    y = tarragones_scale_y + tarragones_map_height * 0.09,
    label = "N",
    color = "#17384a",
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "DejaVu Sans"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = tarragones_extent[c("xmin", "xmax")],
    ylim = tarragones_extent[c("ymin", "ymax")],
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +
  theme_void(base_family = "DejaVu Sans") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#8fc8df", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#ffffff", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

draw_map_title <- function(label, width) {
  grid.roundrect(
    x = 0.025,
    y = 0.965,
    width = width,
    height = 0.075,
    just = c("left", "top"),
    r = unit(0.008, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = adjustcolor("#ffffff", alpha.f = 0.90), col = NA)
  )
  grid.text(
    label,
    x = 0.045,
    y = 0.928,
    just = c("left", "center"),
    gp = gpar(col = "#17384a", fontsize = 17, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans")
  )
}

draw_vila_seca_callout <- function() {
  grid.lines(
    x = c(0.37, 0.28),
    y = c(0.215, 0.34),
    default.units = "npc",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.13, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    gp = gpar(col = "#813022", lwd = 1.5)
  )
  grid.text(
    "Vila-seca",
    x = 0.385,
    y = 0.195,
    just = c("left", "center"),
    gp = gpar(col = "#813022", fontsize = 17, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans")
  )
}

draw_context_map <- function(territorial_context) {
  print(
    territorial_context,
    vp = viewport(x = 0.84, y = 0.79, width = 0.28, height = 0.34)
  )
  grid.rect(
    x = 0.84,
    y = 0.79,
    width = 0.28,
    height = 0.34,
    gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "#ffffff", lwd = 1.4)
  )
}

render_tarragones_locator <- function(output, territorial_context) {
  dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  svglite::svglite(output, width = 8.5, height = 6.125, bg = "white")
  grid.newpage()

  print(
    tarragones_detail,
    vp = viewport(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, width = 0.98, height = 0.96, clip = "on")
  )
  grid.rect(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    width = 0.98,
    height = 0.96,
    gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "#ffffff", lwd = 1.4)
  )
  draw_vila_seca_callout()
  draw_context_map(territorial_context)
  draw_map_title("El Tarragonès", width = 0.25)

  dev.off()
}

render_orthophoto_locator <- function(output, territorial_context) {
  dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  svglite::svglite(output, width = 8.5, height = 6.125, bg = "white")
  grid.newpage()

  pushViewport(viewport(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, width = 0.98, height = 0.96, clip = "on"))
  grid.raster(orthophoto, width = unit(1, "npc"), height = unit(1, "npc"), interpolate = TRUE)
  draw_boundaries(
    visible_municipalities,
    orthophoto_extent,
    gpar(col = adjustcolor("#ffffff", alpha.f = 0.62), lwd = 0.75, linejoin = "round")
  )
  draw_boundaries(vila_seca, orthophoto_extent, gpar(col = "#ffffff", lwd = 5.2, linejoin = "round"))
  draw_boundaries(vila_seca, orthophoto_extent, gpar(col = "#d9472f", lwd = 2.4, linejoin = "round"))

  scale_width <- 2000 / (orthophoto_extent["xmax"] - orthophoto_extent["xmin"])
  scale_x <- 0.72
  scale_y <- 0.065
  grid.lines(
    x = c(scale_x, scale_x + scale_width),
    y = c(scale_y, scale_y),
    default.units = "npc",
    gp = gpar(col = "#ffffff", lwd = 2.5)
  )
  grid.lines(
    x = c(scale_x, scale_x),
    y = c(scale_y - 0.008, scale_y + 0.008),
    default.units = "npc",
    gp = gpar(col = "#ffffff", lwd = 2)
  )
  grid.lines(
    x = c(scale_x + scale_width, scale_x + scale_width),
    y = c(scale_y - 0.008, scale_y + 0.008),
    default.units = "npc",
    gp = gpar(col = "#ffffff", lwd = 2)
  )
  grid.text(
    "2 km",
    x = scale_x + scale_width / 2,
    y = scale_y + 0.04,
    gp = gpar(col = "#ffffff", fontsize = 17, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans")
  )

  grid.polygon(
    x = c(0.93, 0.918, 0.942),
    y = c(0.17, 0.13, 0.13),
    default.units = "npc",
    gp = gpar(fill = "#ffffff", col = "#ffffff")
  )
  grid.lines(
    x = c(0.93, 0.93),
    y = c(0.13, 0.095),
    default.units = "npc",
    gp = gpar(col = "#ffffff", lwd = 2)
  )
  grid.text(
    "N",
    x = 0.93,
    y = 0.19,
    gp = gpar(col = "#ffffff", fontsize = 17, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans")
  )
  grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "#ffffff", lwd = 1.4))
  popViewport()

  draw_context_map(territorial_context)
  draw_map_title("Vila-seca", width = 0.18)

  dev.off()
}

render_tarragones_locator(
  file.path(root, "assets/img/cartographic-language/locator-map-vila-seca.svg"),
  territorial_context_tarragones
)
render_orthophoto_locator(
  file.path(root, "assets/img/cartographic-language/locator-map-vila-seca-direct.svg"),
  territorial_context_vila_seca
)
```
